title: Broncos injury report: Jaylen Waddle, Zach Allen, Pat Surtain and Talanoa Hufanga statuses
text:
Broncos injury report: Jaylen Waddle Waddle, Zach Allen, PS2 update Schedule NFL News Draft Fantasy Odds Betting Newsletter BRONCOS Broncos injury report: Jaylen Waddle, Zach Allen, Pat Surtain and Talanoa Hufanga statuses
 Jon Heath Broncos Wire Updated Oct. 28, 2026, 8:52 p.m. MT The Denver Broncos returned to practice on Wednesday as they begin on-field preparations ahead of Sunday's divisional showdown with the Kansas City Chiefs .
 Safety Talanoa Hufanga ( ankle ), defensive lineman Zach Allen ( hamstring ) and wide receiver Jaylen Waddle ( chest ) did not participate in practice. Hufanga has missed the club's last two games and might be in danger of missing another.
 Waddle and Allen both went down with injuries during a 30-16 win over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday. Allen said, " I'll be fine " following Sunday's game. Waddle has an uncertain status going into Week 8, but 9News has reported there's some hope he'll be able to play on Sunday.
 Elsewhere on the injury front, cornerback Pat Surtain ( ankle ) was a full participant while offensive lineman Garett Bolles (hip) and receiver Marvin Mims (ankle) were limited on Wednesday. Surtain has missed the team's last three games, but he returned to practice in a limited capacity last week and is now fully participating this week.
 Denver's scheduled to practice again on Thursday and Friday before releasing a final injury report with game statuses for Sunday's showdown with the Chiefs. The winner of Sunday's game will hold first place in the AFC West.
